description: This file contains initialization and helper functions for Gitweb tests, which source this shell library instead of test-lib.sh. It includes functions to initialize configurations, run Gitweb in test mode, and setup environment prerequisites for tests.

methods.name: gitweb_init
methods.description: Initializes Gitweb test configuration, sets environment variables, and creates configuration files.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Runs the Gitweb CGI in test mode, capturing headers and body, and managing outputs.
